status: EXPERIMENT, measurement only: no pipeline output and no judge
question: what the AI judge is shown, and what of it needs a decision
what_a_segment_is: a branch of a skeleton, the piece between two junctions, at least 10 px long

kinds.owned: traced by the pipeline and owned by a lacuna
kinds.unowned: traced by the pipeline and owned by nobody
kinds.new: not traced: what the permissive cut finds inside a zone of the hole

classes.a: an unowned segment, with at least one lacuna within reach of it
classes.b: a new segment from the permissive cut inside the zone of the hole
classes.c: a segment that touches a body that does not own it
classes.d: a segment owned by a lacuna that is not the nearest lacuna to it by straight distance, where that nearest lacuna's body lies within its own zone of the hole plus the minimum segment length

within_reach: a lacuna is a candidate for a segment when its body lies within that lacuna's own zone of the hole plus the minimum segment length of the segment; it is the pipeline's zone and no new number
numbered: a segment is numbered, which is what asks the judge for a decision, exactly when it falls in one of the four classes

the_question.a, c, d: which osteocyte does this thread start from
the_question.b: is it a real thread or glow texture, and whose

lacunae_involved: per class, how many lacunae are a candidate for at least one segment of it, so how many cells its answers could move
